images.filename: U.S. Army Cessna O-1 directs naval gunfire support in Vietnam, 18 April 1966 (K-31128).jpg
images.caption:
A U.S. Army Cessna O-1D Bird Dog (s/n 57-2904) observation plane directs 5-inch gunfire from the U.S. Navy destroyer USS Orleck (DD-886) onto a Vietcong position, 18 April 1966. The pilot was Army First Lieutenant Peter S. Ossi and the spotter and gunfire liaison officer was Marine First Lieutenant Gerard G. Garwick.
The O-1D 57-2904 was transferred to Cambodia, in 1971.
images.alt:
A U.S. Army Cessna O-1D Bird Dog (s/n 57-2904) observation plane directs 5-inch gunfire from the U.S. Navy destroyer USS Orleck (DD-886) onto a Vietcong position, 18 April 1966.
